rationale: dual_domain_n2i-claude-agentic: warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, pretrain_steps=100, n_iter=50, grad_clip=1.0, outer_wall_s=1400, per_scene_s=None, batch_size=1, lr=0.0003, optimizer=adam, unet_c=16, train_n=400, val_n=200, seed=42, rationale=iter-17 SIX-BOX. (1) PRIOR: iter-16 hr=0.0, batch_size=2 warm-start gave rmse=0.00634 -- warm-start batch statistics do not matter; still at the plateau. Iters 1-16 all hr=0, rmse tightly in 0.00623-0.00657. (2) FAILURE MODE: plain-UNet N2I at the over-smoothed FBP-consistent plateau; no edge-preserving structural guard (bilateral sibling range kernel hr~0.21). (3) ONE KNOB: relative to iter-6 best reference (n_iter=50, lr=3e-4, c=16, batch_size=1), pretrain_steps 0 -> 100 (a HARD cap on total warm-start optimizer steps -- an alternative bound to pretrain_epochs that stops the amortised pre-pass after exactly 100 steps regardless of epoch boundaries). (4) HYPOTHESIS: capping the warm-start at 100 steps yields a LESS-converged (less over-smoothed) shared init than the full 3-epoch (~1200-step) pre-pass; if a fresher init lowers rmse, warm-start CONVERGENCE (not strength/batch) is the subtle lever. Per the ceiling, expect hr=0 -- any warm-start, however truncated, lands the per-image fits at the same over-smoothed plateau. (5) BUDGET: warm-start hard-capped at 100 steps (fast, ~40s) + 200*50-step fits + figure ~= 10 min << 30-min wall. (6) Loop continues; iter-18 self-dispatched. Reserved levers: warm_start off + n_iter=400 (pure per-image, max steps), per_scene_s explicit=10, n_iter=25 aggressive early-stop.
